description: Derived from issue #608's contract and the pre-fix #623 implementation. Invariant under test: specialists run concurrently -> ALL specialists terminate/reap -> final reviewer starts. A reviewer that only verified 'launched before the final reviewer' but not the reap-before-final boundary must NOT receive coverage credit.
issue_contract_text:
## Requirements

- Specialists MUST run concurrently.
- All specialist workers MUST terminate and be reaped before the final review call starts.
pr_body_text: Runs three specialists as background jobs launched before the final reviewer path.

evidence.detail: background job is launched before the final reviewer call
job is waited on and reaped before the review call
run output shows all specialist pids gone before final request is sent
